E1009

A `{name:...}` rest capture isn't the last part of a binary pattern (D-BINPAT1)

What

A `{name:...}` rest capture isn't the last part of a binary pattern (D-BINPAT1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E1009

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1009: tests/ui/binpat_rest_not_final.stderr.

Error [E1009]: a `{...}` rest capture must be the last part of a binary pattern
  --> tests/ui/binpat_rest_not_final.jet:4:16
    |
  4 |         [U8]{"{rest:...}{tail:U8}"} -> { print("x") }
    |                ^^^^^^^^
 Why: the rest capture takes every remaining byte, so nothing can come after it
 Fix: move the `{name:...}` hole to the end, or give it a fixed width
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1009
